children: agilon health (NYSE: AGL), the trusted partner empowering physicians to transform health care in our communities, today announced the expansion of its relationship with Family Practice Center, PC (FPC) in Pennsylvania, which will join one of agilon’s Senior Health Connect Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs). Family Practice Center, central Pennsylvania’s largest independent primary care physician group serving more than 200,000 patients, entered into a long-term agreement with agilon to transition to a full-risk, value-based care model for certain Medicare patients beginning in 2024.

This expansion will help reach more Traditional Medicare beneficiaries across the communities FPC serves. Through agilon’s ACO, which participates in the Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP), FPC will gain additional support to deliver more coordinated, personalized, patient-centered care focused on prevention, earlier intervention and improved outcomes while helping reduce unnecessary healthcare spending.

agilon brings extensive experience supporting physicians through accountable care models. Since 2021, agilon’s ACOs have generated more than $510 million in gross savings, including $125 million in savings to the Medicare Trust Fund, demonstrating the ability to improve outcomes while reducing costs. In 2024, the most recent year for which quality data is available, agilon’s ACOs achieved an average quality score of 96%. Four of them earned perfect quality scores, and five were recognized as high performers for achieving exceptional results across all quality measures.

“By expanding our work with FPC through agilon’s ACO, we’re building on a shared focus on helping physicians deliver the best care possible for their patients,” said Tim O’Rourke, chief executive officer of agilon health. “The ACO creates more opportunities to address health needs earlier, coordinate care for chronic conditions, and make sure patients have the right care and support as their needs change. It’s a meaningful next step in reaching more seniors and Medicare patients across Pennsylvania.”

Founded in 2016, agilon partners with more than 30 physician groups and health systems to help them succeed in full-risk, value-based care for Medicare Advantage and fee-for-service innovation models.

Through its next-generation technology and AI-enabled platforms, agilon transforms data from across the healthcare ecosystem into actionable insights that help physicians anticipate patient needs, intervene earlier and close care gaps. Specialized clinical pathways for chronic conditions such as heart failure, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and dementia further equips physicians to address complex patient needs and deliver more proactive, coordinated care at scale.

“Expanding our work with agilon gives our physicians more of the tools, insights and day-to-day support they need in an increasingly complex healthcare environment,” said Benjamin Williard, chief executive officer, Family Practice Center, PC. “For us, the value is being able to draw on those capabilities while keeping our physicians at the center of care, preserving their ability to make decisions based on the needs of their patients and communities.”

Building on a strong track record in ACO models, agilon health is well positioned to extend that momentum alongside its physician partners as accountable care evolves. The company's demonstrated success in driving quality outcomes and generating shared savings under ACO models provides a proven foundation as participating ACOs look to the future.

With its long-term care model, deep primary care relationships and infrastructure built for value-based performance, agilon and its ACO partners are poised to capture significant opportunities for continued growth and strong performance across both models. This continuity reflects agilon's enduring commitment to helping community physicians thrive in accountable care and improve outcomes for the seniors they serve.

Family Practice Center, PC, is a physician-led, community-driven healthcare organization serving over 200,000 patients across Central Pennsylvania. Founded in 1973, FPC today operates more than 40 physician offices and more than 40 physical therapy offices. FPC provides comprehensive care to patients of all ages, with services including family medicine, pediatrics, Medicare wellness visits, disease management, diagnostics, sleep medicine and physical therapy. Guided by its mission to provide exceptional and compassionate healthcare, FPC is committed to a patient-centered medical home model focused on improving treatment outcomes and enhancing quality of life in the communities it serves.

agilon health is the trusted partner empowering physicians to transform health care in our communities. Through our partnerships and purpose-built platform, agilon is accelerating at scale how physician groups and health systems transition to a value-based Total Care Model for their senior patients. agilon provides the technology, people, capital, process and access to a peer network of approximately 2,300 primary care physicians (PCPs) that allow its physician partners to maintain their independence and focus on the total health of their most vulnerable patients. Together, agilon and its physician partners are creating the healthcare system we need – one built on the value of care, not the volume of fees. The result: healthier communities and empowered doctors. agilon is the trusted partner in approximately 30 communities and is here to help more of our nation's leading physician groups and health systems have a sustained, thriving future. For more information, visit agilonhealth.com and connect with us on LinkedIn.
